propositions: Core push delivery implements exactly five retry cycles plus one conditional terminal push to achieve Compare-and-Swap ordering
Strict delivery mode raises catchable PushDeliveryError with stable failure reasons and is translated to process exit only at the Python adapter boundary
All pre-existing library, CLI, and store-write callers retain best-effort default behavior by omitting strict parameter or reaching core with strict=False
Strict delivery does not emit ticket events, BRIDGE_ALERT, or modify persisted schema and preserves backward compatibility with existing environments
Python adapter owns the process boundary translating PushDeliveryError to stderr and nonzero exit for workflow automation
All eleven stable failure reasons distinguish policy decline from transport failure with git detail and unpushed commit count
